 I compared the Galaxy S27 Ultra Dummy to the S26 Ultra and iPhone 18 Pro
 Alexander Maxham | Nov 2, 2026 
 Add Android Headlines as a preferred source on Google 
 Summary
 We got our hands on a Galaxy S27 Ultra dummy built from our exclusive CAD files. Next to the Galaxy S26 Ultra and iPhone 18 Pro, the redesigned camera bar finally makes room for magnetic accessories that actually stick.
 This is what the Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra will look like. We built this Galaxy S27 Ultra dummy unit from the same CAD files we published in August , and it shows Samsung’s next-generation flagship with its brand-new design. If you need a phone now, check out our list of the Samsung phones worth buying today.
 This is a dummy shell, so it doesn’t have the real weight. There’s no display, battery, or anything else inside. A dummy unit like this lets case makers build cases for the new phone ahead of time, so they’re ready when Unpacked happens in January or February.
 The body barely changes. The Galaxy S27 Ultra measures 163.76 x 78.25 x 7.97mm, compared to 163.6 x 78.1 x 7.9mm for the Galaxy S26 Ultra. So the Galaxy S27 Ultra is a hair larger, but that’s not the most interesting part of this device.
 Table of Contents
 Toggle 
 The Galaxy S27 Ultra redesign 
 Galaxy S26 Ultra vs Galaxy S27 Ultra 
 iPhone 18 Pro vs Galaxy S27 Ultra 
 Pixel 11 Pro vs Galaxy S27 Ultra 
 When will the Galaxy S27 Ultra be announced? 
 Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra FAQ 
 The Galaxy S27 Ultra redesign 
 Everyone has hated the Galaxy S27 Ultra redesign since we leaked the CAD renders a few months ago, but I’m one of the few who actually like it. Now that I have the dummy unit in my hand, I like it even more.
 The biggest reason? Magnetic charging. Samsung has kept built-in Qi2 magnets out of the Galaxy S lineup, largely because magnets can interfere with the S Pen. That could still be an issue on the Galaxy S27 Ultra, which keeps the S Pen slot. But moving the cameras higher leaves room for magnets, so MagSafe-style accessories will connect properly.
 The Galaxy S26 Ultra works with magnetic accessories if you use a Qi2 magnetic case, but the cameras were the problem. The camera bump is so large and extends so far down that things like battery packs didn’t connect completely. That made them run very warm and charge the phone slowly. This design fixes that.
 The other reason I like this design is table wobble. I expected the new camera bar to help, and it does, to a point. When I set the dummy unit down, it sits still. But tap the screen, particularly in the lower right-hand corner, and it still wobbles a decent amount.
 Take the wobble with a grain of salt, though. This is a dummy unit, and it isn’t the correct weight, so the final phone could behave differently.
 Galaxy S26 Ultra vs Galaxy S27 Ultra 
 The good news? You can tell them apart. The bad news? A lot of people will hate this redesign because it’s different and looks similar to the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. But let’s start with the Galaxy S26 Ultra vs. Galaxy S27 Ultra.
 The first thing you’ll notice is the new camera bar on the Galaxy S27 Ultra, and one fewer camera . Samsung is rumored to be ditching the 3x telephoto this year, sticking with the 200MP main camera, a 50MP ultrawide, and a 50MP 5x telephoto. As you can see here, that telephoto is going to be tiny. Then again, it was already tiny on the Galaxy S26 Ultra. It just looked larger than it was.
 Samsung is putting a raised bump on top of the camera bar, so there are really two layers here. Samsung and other OEMs have done this for a while, so it isn’t a huge surprise. Still, I’d like to see these cameras sit flush with the bar, as they do on the Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro XL .
 The rest of the design looks the same. The S Pen is still on the bottom left, followed by the speaker, the USB-C port, and then the SIM card tray. The power and volume buttons are on the right, with power below volume, the opposite of how Google does it on Pixel.
 So that’s the Galaxy S26 Ultra versus the Galaxy S27 Ultra, barring any major design changes before Unpacked early next year.
 Will Galaxy S26 Ultra cases fit the Galaxy S27 Ultra?
 No. Unfortunately, because Samsung changed the camera design this year, all Galaxy S26 Ultra cases will be incompatible with the Galaxy S27 Ultra. You might get lucky with a case that has the entire top cut out; that could work. But for 99% of cases, they will be incompatible. 
 As you can see in the images below, if it weren’t for the camera redesign, the Galaxy S27 Ultra would fit Galaxy S26 Ultra cases. But with that redesign, it won’t. 
 iPhone 18 Pro vs Galaxy S27 Ultra 
 Then there’s the iPhone 18 Pro. Yes, they look similar, thanks to the new camera bar. Samsung isn’t the only one doing this, by the way. We’ve already seen many other Android phones take this route. It makes the most sense for magnetic charging, and it frees up room for a bigger battery and potentially larger cameras.
 What’s interesting is that the Galaxy S27 Ultra’s camera bar is much larger than the one on my iPhone 18 Pro. I’m comparing it to the smaller iPhone 18 Pro, not the Pro Max, so that could be why.
 Pixel 11 Pro vs Galaxy S27 Ultra 
 I stand by my opinion that Google did the camera bar right, and did it first. Google introduced its camera bar with the Pixel 6 and reworked it into a pill-shaped island with the Pixel 9 , well before the iPhone and Galaxy adopted a similar look. The Pixel 11 Pro is still better in my book, since its cameras sit flush in the bar. Sure, its bar is a bit thicker than the Galaxy S27 Ultra’s, but that’s what makes the flush lenses possible. And the best part? No table wobble at all.
 It’s a bit amazing that the industry is following Pixel, not Apple, with this camera bar design. Still, I’d say Google’s design is better, largely because it doesn’t wobble at all, mostly thanks to the cameras being flush in the camera bar. 
 When will the Galaxy S27 Ultra be announced? 
 We’re still three to four months out from the Galaxy S27 series becoming official. Last year, Samsung held Unpacked on February 25, right before MWC . The two years before that, it held Unpacked in late January, right after CES . So either is fair game, but I’d put my money on another late-February launch. My guess is the week of February 22, since Mobile World Congress kicks off in Barcelona on March 1.
 Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra FAQ 
 Does the Galaxy S27 Ultra have an S Pen? Yes. Based on our CAD renderings, the Galaxy S27 Ultra will continue to include an S Pen, and it will remain built into the phone. 
 How many cameras does the Galaxy S27 Ultra have? It will have three rear cameras, plus the front-facing camera. 
 Will the Galaxy S27 Ultra have built-in magnets? We don’t know for sure, but we’re leaning towards yes. Mainly because of this redesign. 
 Will Galaxy S26 Ultra cases fit the Galaxy S27 Ultra? No. Mainly due to the camera redesign. The rest of the phone has the same dimensions, but the camera redesign makes Galaxy S26 Ultra cases unusable, as shown above. 
 When will the Galaxy S27 Ultra be announced? Samsung should announce the Galaxy S27 Ultra at its Winter Unpacked event in January or February 2027.
